visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit office environment. A male character with short, brown hair wearing a white T-shirt sits at a desk cluttered with monitors and a guitar in the background. Two hands enter the frame holding two yellow cards with handwritten text. The character looks apprehensive, squinting his eyes and smiling nervously as he selects one of the cards. (2) The setting shifts to an outdoor area in front of a modern building with large glass windows. The male character now has a yellow towel draped around his neck, looking towards the sky with a squinted expression due to the bright daylight. A digital graphic of a blue shampoo bottle appears on the right side of the screen with glowing accents. (3) The scene transitions to an indoor fitness facility with specialized athletic equipment like ropes and bars. The main character stands with his hands on his hips, talking to a shorter male coach in a black polo shirt. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the high ceilings and various training structures in the background. (4) A rapid sequence of physical challenges follows. The character is seen jumping over black wooden obstacles, swinging from red rings attached to the ceiling, and climbing a tall, curved black wall labeled 'GYMEFIT NINJA'. He appears sweaty, with his hair slightly disheveled but still maintaining some volume. He reaches the top and celebrates by holding up two small signs. (5) The environment changes to a clean, indoor studio with 'THE DODOMEN' logo on the wall. The character stands behind a table displaying three different blue bottles of Head & Shoulders shampoo. He demonstrates the product by pouring a clear gel into his hand and washing his hair in a shower setting, creating white foam and lathering his scalp thoroughly. (6) The video concludes back in the gym lobby. The character, still in his white T-shirt and carrying a blue bottle, interacts with a staff member who hands him a small voucher. He smiles and laughs, looking back at the camera with a playful expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic synthesizer BGM. A male voice speaks rapidly with high energy and laughter, followed by a soft percussive sound of paper being handled. (2) The acoustic texture shifts to include a light outdoor environmental hum. The narration continues with a friendly, casual tone. A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as a graphic appears. (3) Upon entering the gym, a subtle room reverb is audible. The main male speaker's voice is joined by a second male voice with a lower pitch and calm professional delivery. (4) As the challenge starts, the BGM shifts to a higher-tempo electronic track with a heavy bass beat. Frequent 'whoosh' and 'thud' sound effects punctuate the movements, synchronized with the athletic actions. (5) In the studio section, the background music becomes smoother and more melodic. A distinct splashing and bubbling sound effect is introduced, mimicking the sound of water and soap lathering. (6) The final phase features a female voice offering a reward, followed by a playful, cartoonish slide-whistle sound effect as the character laughs and the BGM swells to a close.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Challenge -> Product Integration -> Reward
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'office prank' hook to transition into a physical fitness challenge, ultimately serving as an integrated advertisement for Head & Shoulders shampoo. It demonstrates the product's effectiveness in maintaining hair volume and scalp freshness even after intense, sweaty exercise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The character explicitly names the brand, displays the packaging, and demonstrates product use in a dedicated review segment.
